q: Which is an advanced capability of Hermes Agent?
explanation: Voice mode lets you talk to the agent; it transcribes, works, and replies with spoken TTS on recent models.

q: When code should not have direct access to the host, what should you do?
options: Directly on your bare system at full access
Use an isolated terminal backend such as Docker and mount only what the task needs
Only on a machine you don't care about
explanation: The execute_code tool is not automatically a security sandbox. Use an isolated backend and narrow mounts when the task requires separation.

q: What is the main advantage of running a local model via Ollama?
options: Smarter reasoning than any cloud model
explanation: Local inference can keep model prompts on-device, but only if the workflow does not call hosted tools or services.
